## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `Integrations`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `integrations`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **Integrations**.

## Step 2: Integration as API

1. <!-- manual: In the console, go to Admin › Scaling. -->
2. <!-- manual: Disable Scale to zero for the relevant environment. -->
3. <!-- manual: Return to the integration overview page. You can now stop and start the deployment for each environment. -->

## Step 3: Delete an integration

1. <!-- manual: Click the project name in the top navigation to go to the project view. -->
2. <!-- manual: In the list of integrations, hover over the integration you want to delete. A Delete button appears. -->
3. Select **Delete**, then enter the integration name to confirm.
4. <!-- manual: enter the integration name to confirm -->
